name: io.github.WickedAPI/wicked-mcp
title: Wicked MCP
description: Whole Wicked suite for agents: market data, SEC filings, wallet checks, risk, identity, memory.

tools.name: kalshi_probability
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Free, no signup required. Kalshi prediction-market probabilities. Query by category (returns the most active open markets) or a specific market ticker.

**Example:** `/v1/kalshi-probability?category=crypto`

Use when you want live Kalshi prediction-market probabilities by category or ticker. Not for a single market's depth (use kalshi_market) or Polymarket (use polymarket).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

category.description: Optional. One of: crypto, macro, fed-rate, financials, politics, sports, world, companies, climate, science, health, entertainment, elections. Either category or ticker is required.

ticker.description: Optional. A specific Kalshi market ticker (e.g. KXBTCD-...).

limit.description: Optional. Max markets to return for a category query (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: kalshi_market
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Single Kalshi market depth: orderbook (yes/no levels) + recent trades for a specific ticker.

**Example:** `/v1/kalshi-market?ticker=KXBTCD-26JUN1315-T64099.99`

Use when you need one Kalshi market's orderbook and recent trades by ticker. Not for browsing markets by category (use kalshi_probability).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

ticker.description: Required. A Kalshi market ticker (e.g. KXBTCD-26JUN1315-T64099.99).

depth.description: Optional. Orderbook depth per side (default 10, max 100).

trades.description: Optional. Recent trades to return (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: funding_oi
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Aggregated perpetual-futures funding rate & open interest from Binance + Bybit, with 7-day average funding, 24h OI change, and a long/short bias signal.

**Example:** `/v1/funding-oi?symbol=BTC`

Use when you want perp funding rates and open interest aggregated from Binance and Bybit to gauge leverage and crowding. Not for Hyperliquid-specific data (use hyperliquid) or spot-vs-perp carry (use basis).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. Base crypto symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL). Mapped to the <SYMBOL>USDT perpetual ticker on Binance/Bybit.

tools.name: long_short_ratio
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Binance long/short ratios: global account, top-trader account, top-trader position, and taker buy/sell. Companion to funding-oi.

**Example:** `/v1/long-short-ratio?symbol=BTC&period=1h`

Use when you want Binance positioning ratios (global accounts, top traders, taker buy/sell). Not for funding or open interest (use funding_oi).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. Base crypto symbol (e.g. BTC). Mapped to <SYMBOL>USDT.

tools.name: orderbook
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Top-of-book depth + spread (bps) from Binance, Bybit, or Hyperliquid.

**Example:** `/v1/orderbook?symbol=BTC&exchange=binance&depth=10`

Use when you need top-of-book depth and spread (bps) on Binance, Bybit or Hyperliquid. Not for a prediction-market book (use kalshi_market).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

tools.name: basis
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Spot-vs-perp basis (premium %) with funding-implied annualized carry. Spot from Coinbase; perp marks from Binance + Bybit.

**Example:** `/v1/basis?symbol=BTC`

Use when you want the spot-vs-perp premium and funding-implied annualized carry for a basis trade. Not for raw funding data (use funding_oi).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

tools.name: hyperliquid
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Hyperliquid perpetual context: funding (hourly), open interest, mark/oracle/mid price, premium, 24h volume. Not geo-blocked.

**Example:** `/v1/hyperliquid?symbol=BTC`

Use when you need Hyperliquid perp context: funding, open interest, mark/oracle price, premium and volume. Not for Binance/Bybit aggregates (use funding_oi).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. Hyperliquid coin name (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL).

tools.name: volatility
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Deribit volatility: DVOL implied-vol index (30d forward) + latest realized volatility, for BTC or ETH.

**Example:** `/v1/volatility?currency=BTC`

Use when you want Deribit implied volatility (DVOL) next to realized volatility for BTC or ETH. Not for other assets or ATR-style sizing (use atr).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

tools.name: sentiment
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Free, no signup required. Crypto Fear & Greed Index (alternative.me), current reading + optional history.

**Example:** `/v1/sentiment?limit=7`

Use when you want the crypto Fear & Greed reading as a quick market-mood signal. Not for asset-specific direction (use momentum_score).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

limit.description: Optional. Number of days of history (default 1, max 90).

tools.name: defi_tvl
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] DefiLlama data: TVL by chain, stablecoin circulating supply, or yield pools.

**Example:** `/v1/defi-tvl?view=chains`

Use when you need DeFi TVL by chain, stablecoin supply or yield pools from DefiLlama. Not for the health or risk of one protocol (use protocol_health_score).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

chain.description: Optional (yields view). Filter pools by chain, e.g. Ethereum.

project.description: Optional (yields view). Filter pools by project, e.g. aave-v3.

tools.name: price
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Current spot price for crypto (Coinbase) or US equities/ETFs (Alpaca SIP), via the shared routing layer.

**Example:** `/v1/price?symbol=BTC`

Use when you need the current spot price of one crypto asset or US stock/ETF. Not for history or candles (use ohlcv), or a trading view (use momentum_score or verdict).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. e.g. BTC, ETH, SUI, NVDA, SPY.

class.description: Optional. stock|crypto — required for symbols outside the curated list.

tools.name: ohlcv
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] OHLCV candles (oldest-first) for crypto or stocks. Routes to Alpaca SIP / Alpaca-crypto / Coinbase.

**Example:** `/v1/ohlcv?symbol=NVDA&timeframe=1h&limit=100`

Use when you need historical candles to chart or compute indicators yourself. Not for only the latest price (use price) or a ready-made indicator (atr, fvg, liquidity_levels).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

tools.name: atr
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Average True Range (Wilder's) + volatility-regime classification (low/normal/high/extreme by historical percentile). Crypto or stocks.

**Example:** `/v1/atr?symbol=BTC&timeframe=1h&period=14`

Use when you need volatility for position sizing or stops: Wilder ATR plus a low/normal/high/extreme regime. Not for implied volatility for BTC/ETH (use volatility).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. e.g. BTC, NVDA, SPY (or any with &class=).

tools.name: rates
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] US Treasury yield curve (1M–30Y) + recession-indicator spreads (10y-2y, 10y-3m), from FRED.

**Example:** `/v1/rates`

Use when you need the US Treasury yield curve and recession spreads (10y-2y, 10y-3m). Not for event dates (use macro_calendar).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

series.description: Optional. A specific FRED series id (e.g. DGS10) for a single value.

tools.name: market_clock
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] US equities market clock (is_open, next_open/close) + upcoming sessions, via Alpaca. Crypto endpoints are 24/7 and unaffected.

**Example:** `/v1/market-clock`

Use when you need to know whether US equity markets are open and when the next session opens or closes. Not for crypto, which trades 24/7.

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

days.description: Optional. Upcoming session days to include (default 3, max 30; 0 to omit).

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Free, no signup required. CoinGecko global crypto stats (total market cap, 24h volume, BTC/ETH dominance) or top coins by market cap.

**Example:** `/v1/market-overview`

Use when you want global crypto stats: total market cap, 24h volume, BTC and ETH dominance. Not for a single asset's price (use price).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

limit.description: Optional (coins view). Number of coins (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: gas
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Free, no signup required. Ethereum gas oracle (safe/propose/fast gas prices + base fee, in gwei), via Etherscan.

**Example:** `/v1/gas`

Use when you need current Ethereum gas prices (safe, standard, fast) and the base fee before sending a transaction. Not for other chains.

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

tools.name: fvg
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Fair Value Gap zones (standard ICT/LuxAlgo) with CE (50%), gap size, age, fill status, distance from price. Standard timeframes match TradingView candles. Crypto or stocks.

**Example:** `/v1/fvg?symbol=BTC&timeframe=1h`

Use when you want Fair Value Gap zones (ICT-style imbalances) with fill status and distance from price. Not for swing-high/low liquidity pools (use liquidity_levels).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. e.g. BTC, NVDA, SPY (or any with &class=).

include_filled.description: Optional. true to include filled FVGs (default false = active only).

min_gap_pct.description: Optional. Filter out gaps smaller than this % of price (default 0 = all).

lookback.description: Optional. Timeframe candles to analyze (default 120, max 500).

tools.name: liquidity_levels
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] ICT liquidity levels: buy-side liquidity (above swing highs) & sell-side (below swing lows), sweep/taken status, relative-equal pools, and nearest untaken targets. Crypto or stocks.

**Example:** `/v1/liquidity-levels?symbol=TQQQ&timeframe=1h`

Use when you want buy-side/sell-side liquidity levels and whether they were swept. Not for gap zones (use fvg) or actual liquidation events (use liquidations).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. e.g. BTC, NVDA, TQQQ (or any with &class=).

swing_length.description: Optional. Pivot strength — bars each side of a swing (default 5). Tune to match your chart indicator.

equal_threshold_pct.description: Optional. Group swings within this % as relative-equal pools (default 0.1).

include_swept.description: Optional. true to include already-taken levels (default false = resting only).

tools.name: macro_calendar
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Free, no signup required. Upcoming US macro events (FOMC rate decisions, CPI, jobs report) with verified Fed/BLS dates, days-until, and Kalshi rate-decision odds (cut/hold/hike) for FOMC meetings.

**Example:** `/v1/macro-calendar`

Use when you want upcoming US macro events (FOMC, CPI, jobs) with verified dates. Not for company earnings (use earnings_calendar).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

days.description: Optional. Only events within the next N days.

type.description: Optional. Filter to FOMC, CPI, or NFP.

tools.name: earnings_calendar
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] US equity earnings announcement calendar: report date, before/after-market timing, analyst EPS estimate + count, market cap, and prior-year actual EPS. Sourced live from Nasdaq's public calendar.

**Example:** `/v1/earnings-calendar?date=2026-07-14&days=3`

Use when you want upcoming US earnings dates, timing and analyst estimates. Not for macro events (use macro_calendar) or filed reports (use filings_search).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

days.description: Optional. Days to scan forward from date (default 1, max 7).

symbol.description: Optional. Filter to one ticker within the scanned range.

tools.name: wallet_portfolio
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] What a wallet holds: native balance plus major ERC-20 tokens (stablecoins, wrapped assets, large caps) across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon, with live USD prices, per-chain and total value. Address or ENS name. Reads the chain directly; tokens outside the curated list are not shown (the response states this).

**Example:** `/v1/wallet-portfolio?address=vitalik.eth&chain=all`

Use when you want what a wallet holds in one call: native balance plus major ERC-20 tokens across supported chains. Not for one specific token (use chain_token_balance) or counterparty risk (use wallet_check).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

chain.description: Optional. all (default), ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism or polygon.

tools.name: verdict
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] One-call trading verdict for an asset: LONG, SHORT or NEUTRAL bias with a 0-10 confidence, a one-line thesis, entry, invalidation and two targets, and the trend / momentum / structure / liquidity readings behind it. Mechanical scoring from live candles on two timeframes (EMA stack, MACD, RSI, ADX, swing structure, liquidity sweeps, volume point of control), never a guess. BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, NVDA, IBIT, COIN, QQQ, TQQQ, DIA.

**Example:** `/v1/verdict?symbol=BTC&timeframe=1h`

Use when you want one call that returns a LONG/SHORT/NEUTRAL bias with a 0-10 confidence and a one-line thesis. Not for the full structured levels (use momentum_score, an alias of the same engine) or raw inputs (use price, atr).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. One of: BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, NVDA, IBIT, COIN, QQQ, TQQQ, DIA.

timeframe.description: Optional. Execution timeframe: 15m, 1h, 4h, 1D, 1W (default 1h); the next timeframe up is used as context.

tools.name: momentum_score
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Alias of /v1/verdict. Multi-asset momentum verdict (bias, confidence, thesis, entry/invalidation/targets, signal readings) from the oracle.py pipeline, run on a separate Python service. Scoped to 10 assets.

**Example:** `/v1/momentum-score?symbol=BTC&timeframe=1h`

Use when you want a ready-made LONG/SHORT/NEUTRAL view with confidence, thesis and entry/invalidation/targets for a supported asset. Not for raw inputs (use price, atr, funding_oi). Same data as verdict, which is the newer name.

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. One of: BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, NVDA, IBIT, COIN, QQQ, TQQQ, DIA.

tools.name: chain_balance
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Native-token balance (ETH/POL) for any address or ENS name on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon. Live from the chain over redundant RPCs — wei plus formatted units.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-balance?address=vitalik.eth&chain=ethereum`

Use when you need the native-token balance (ETH/POL) of an address or ENS name on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon. Not for token balances (use chain_token_balance) or a full holdings view (use wallet_portfolio).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

address.description: Required. A 0x address or an ENS name (e.g. vitalik.eth).

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

tools.name: chain_token_balance
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] ERC-20 token balance for an address or ENS name, with token symbol and decimals read from the contract. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-token-balance?address=0xB71C06dAC44c91bc997FB84C247DeEF676F4A9f6&token=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913&chain=base`

Use when you need the balance of one ERC-20 token for an address or ENS name. Not for native balance (chain_balance) or everything a wallet holds (wallet_portfolio).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

address.description: Required. Holder: a 0x address or an ENS name.

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

tools.name: chain_nonce
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Transaction count (nonce) for an address or ENS name: confirmed nonce plus pending nonce, so an agent can sign the next transaction without a collision.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-nonce?address=0xB71C06dAC44c91bc997FB84C247DeEF676F4A9f6&chain=base`

Use when you need an address's confirmed and pending transaction count before building a transaction. Not for balances.

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

address.description: Required. A 0x address or an ENS name.

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

tools.name: chain_block
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Block header lookup: number, hash, timestamp, miner, tx count, gas used/limit and base fee. Latest by default, or any block number, safe or finalized.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-block?chain=base&block=latest`

Use when you need a block header (number, hash, time, miner, gas, base fee), latest by default. Not for a single transaction (use chain_tx).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

block.description: Optional. A block number, "latest", "safe" or "finalized" (default latest).

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

tools.name: chain_ens
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] ENS lookup on Ethereum mainnet in either direction: name to address, or address to primary name.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-ens?name=vitalik.eth`

Use when you need to resolve an ENS name to an address, or an address to its primary ENS name. Not for non-ENS lookups.

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

name.description: Optional. An ENS name to resolve (e.g. vitalik.eth). Either name or address is required.

address.description: Optional. An address to reverse-resolve to its primary ENS name.

tools.name: chain_tx
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Transaction lookup by hash: status (success/reverted/pending), block, from/to, value, nonce, gas used, effective gas price and log count.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-tx?hash=0x...&chain=base`

Use when you need the status and details of a transaction by hash. Not for account-level data (use chain_balance or chain_nonce).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

tools.name: polymarket
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Polymarket prediction markets with live probabilities: question, per-outcome probability, 24h and total volume, liquidity, best bid/ask, one-day price change and end date. Top markets by volume, liquidity or soonest end, or free-text search.

**Example:** `/v1/polymarket?q=bitcoin&limit=5`

Use when you want Polymarket markets with live per-outcome probabilities and volume. Not for Kalshi markets (use kalshi_probability).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

q.description: Optional. Free-text search, e.g. bitcoin, fed rate, election.

sort.description: Optional. volume (default), liquidity or ending. Ignored when q is set.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Real-time web search for agents: ranked results with title, URL, snippet and score, plus an optional synthesized answer. Pay per search; general or news topic.

**Example:** `/v1/web-search?q=latest+ethereum+upgrade&max_results=5&topic=news`

Use when an agent needs fresh web results with titles, URLs and snippets. Not for verifying a claim (use sanity_check with mode open).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

include_answer.description: Optional. true (default) or false to skip the synthesized answer.

tools.name: crypto_news
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Latest crypto headlines aggregated from Cointelegraph, Decrypt and Bitcoin Magazine, newest first: title, source, URL, published time and a short summary. Filter by keyword or source.

**Example:** `/v1/crypto-news?q=etf&limit=10`

Use when you want the latest crypto headlines from major outlets, newest first. Not for market data.

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

q.description: Optional. Keyword filter on title and summary.

source.description: Optional. cointelegraph, decrypt or bitcoinmagazine (default all).

tools.name: liquidations
tools.description:
[Trading Data API] Recent forced liquidations on OKX USDT perpetual swaps for a coin: each event with time, liquidated side, bankruptcy price, size and USD notional, plus long vs short liquidated totals and the largest event. Real exchange data, no estimates.

**Example:** `/v1/liquidations?coin=ETH&limit=50`

Use when you want recent forced liquidations on OKX USDT perpetuals for a coin, with side and size. Not for liquidity pools (use liquidity_levels).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

coin.description: Optional. Ticker such as BTC (default), ETH, SOL.

tools.name: protocol_health_scoreboard
tools.description:
[Protocol Health Oracle] Public teaser: protocol name, score, and verdict only (no components/history) across the full tracked universe — auto-ingested from DefiLlama (TVL > $1M) plus curated protocols.

Use when you want the free public ranking of every tracked DeFi protocol: name, score and verdict only. Not for the component breakdown for one protocol (use protocol_health_score).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

category.description: Optional. Filter by DefiLlama category, e.g. "Liquid Staking".

min_tvl.description: Optional. Only protocols with TVL >= this USD amount.

tools.name: protocol_health_list_protocols
tools.description:
[Protocol Health Oracle] All tracked protocols with their latest health score and verdict.

Use when you need every tracked protocol with its latest score and verdict. Not for one protocol's details (use protocol_health_score).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

min_tvl.description: Optional. Only protocols with TVL >= this USD amount.

tools.name: protocol_health_track_protocol
tools.description:
[Protocol Health Oracle] Track a new protocol. Scored immediately from live GitHub + DeFiLlama data.

Use when a protocol you care about is not tracked yet and you want it scored from live GitHub and DefiLlama data. Not for reading an existing score.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

treasury_address.description: Optional. On-chain treasury address to score (Etherscan balance).

tools.name: protocol_health_score
tools.description:
[Protocol Health Oracle] Latest health score for one protocol: components (GitHub activity, TVL trend, treasury), source details, and score history.

Use when you are vetting one protocol before integrating it and want GitHub activity, TVL trend and treasury components. Not for a ranking (use protocol_health_scoreboard) or token contract risk (use token_risk).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

slug.description: Required (path). The protocol's defillama_slug, e.g. lido.

history.description: Optional. Number of historical scores to include (default 10, max 100).

tools.name: protocol_health_refresh_all
tools.description:
[Protocol Health Oracle] Force an immediate live re-score of all tracked protocols.

Use when you need every tracked protocol re-scored right now instead of waiting for the schedule. Not for a single protocol (read it with protocol_health_score).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

tools.name: protocol_health_sync_universe
tools.description:

tools.name: identity_submit_response
tools.description:
[Wicked Identity] Submit your answer to a challenge; scored pass / fail / inconclusive. A pass returns a short-lived signed assertion_token (JWT) verifiable via identity_jwks. Real wallet: needs a DIFFERENT fresh nonce than identity_get_challenge used. Sandbox: wallet + sandbox_token.

Use when you have the challenge answer and want it scored and, on a pass, a signed assertion token. Not for getting the challenge (use identity_get_challenge).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

wallet.description: Your 0x wallet address on Base, or the sandbox wallet from identity_sandbox_register.

nonce.description: Real wallet: nonce from a FRESH identity_get_nonce call. Omit for sandbox.

signature.description: Real wallet: 0x-prefixed ECDSA signature over that nonce's message. Omit for sandbox.

sandbox_token.description: Sandbox identity: the sandbox_token from identity_sandbox_register. Use INSTEAD of nonce/signature.

response_text.description: Your answer exactly as the instructions specify: raw text only.

tools.name: identity_status
tools.description:
[Wicked Identity] Does a wallet currently hold a valid, unexpired assertion? No signature needed. Pays via x402, or pass api_key (get one free from identity_get_test_key) / set IDENTITY_API_KEY. Sandbox wallets are never `verified`; they report sandbox: true and sandbox_verified instead.

Use when you want to know whether a wallet currently holds a valid, unexpired agent assertion. Not for becoming verified (start with identity_get_nonce).

Behavior: read-only.

tools.name: identity_jwks
tools.description:
[Wicked Identity] Public RS256 keys to verify an assertion_token locally. Free. Set sandbox=true for the separate key set that signs sandbox assertions.

Use when you want the public keys to verify an assertion token locally. Not for checking a wallet's status (use identity_status).

Behavior: read-only.

sandbox.description: true = the sandbox key set (issuer wicked-identity-sandbox).

tools.name: sanity_check
tools.description:
[Wicked Sanity] Verify one claim before acting on it. Verdicts: supported | contradicted | unsupported | insufficient_evidence (see `data`). confidence_score is raw consistency (a "contradicted" verdict scores near 0). Policy: act on supported; treat unsupported/insufficient_evidence as unverified; reject contradicted. x402 or SANITY_API_KEY; 429 means a rate limit — see retry_after.

Use when you must verify one claim before acting on it, either against source text you supply or against live web evidence. Not for many claims at once (use sanity_check_batch).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

claim.description: The single statement to verify (max 5,000 chars).

context.description: Source text the claim(s) must be faithful to. Required for mode "grounded".

mode.description: "grounded" (default; check against context) or "open" (check against live web evidence — consistency with the web, not objective truth).

tools.name: sanity_check_batch
tools.description:
[Wicked Sanity] Verify up to 50 claims against one shared context in a single call — prefer this over one sanity_check per sentence. `data` is a list in the same order as `claims`.

Use when you have a multi-sentence output to verify against one shared context in a single call (up to 50 claims). Not for a single claim (use sanity_check).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

context.description: Source text the claim(s) must be faithful to. Required for mode "grounded".

mode.description: "grounded" (default; check against context) or "open" (check against live web evidence — consistency with the web, not objective truth).

tools.name: sanity_get_check
tools.description:
[Wicked Sanity] Fetch a previously run check by its check_id (returned by sanity_check / sanity_check_batch). x402 or SANITY_API_KEY like the other Sanity calls.

Use when you want to re-read an earlier check by its check_id. Not for running a new check.

Behavior: read-only.

check_id.description: The check_id from an earlier sanity_check result.

tools.name: memory_prepare
tools.description:
Wicked Memory step 1 of every call: returns the exact `message_to_sign`. Sign it with your own wallet (EIP-191 personal_sign), then call the matching memory_* tool with the SAME arguments plus the returned timestamp, nonce and your signature. Timestamp must be within 5 minutes; nonce is single-use, so prepare again for every call.

Use when you are about to call any other memory tool and need the exact message to sign for that request. Not for the call itself.

Behavior: pure local computation, no network call, nothing is stored.

wallet.description: Your agent's 0x wallet address (memories are scoped to it).

params.description: The arguments you will pass to the tool, by name, e.g. {"content":"...","tags":["a"]} or {"memory_id":"<uuid>"}.

tools.name: memory_store
tools.description:
[Wicked Memory] Store a memory (free, fair-use rate limited). A real embedding is computed at write time. Run memory_prepare with operation 'store' and these same arguments first.

Use when you want to save something for later, scoped to your wallet. Not for changing an existing memory (use memory_update).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over memory_prepare's message_to_sign.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description:
[Wicked Memory] Semantic search over YOUR memories only, ranked by real cosine similarity. The one metered call: free with MEMORY_API_KEY, otherwise http_status 402 with x402 v2 instructions under `payment_required` (0.001 USDC on Base) — pay, then call again with the SAME arguments (a 402 does not consume the nonce) plus payment_signature.

Use when you want to recall your memories by meaning rather than by id. Not for fetching a known id (use memory_get).

Behavior: read-only.

q.description: What to look for, in natural language.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over memory_prepare's message_to_sign.

tags.description: Only memories having ALL of these tags.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 instant; search memory as it stood then.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload (base64) for the keyless path.

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description:
[Wicked Memory] Fetch one of your memories by id (another wallet's or a deleted id returns the same 404).

Use when you have a memory id and want its content. Not for searching by meaning (use memory_search).

Behavior: read-only.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over memory_prepare's message_to_sign.

tools.name: memory_update
tools.description:
[Wicked Memory] Update without overwriting: creates a new version and closes the old one (valid_until / superseded_by). Omitted fields carry over; only the current version can be updated (409 otherwise).

Use when you want to change a memory while keeping its history (a new version supersedes the old). Not for removing it (use memory_delete).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

memory_id.description: UUID of the CURRENT version to supersede.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over memory_prepare's message_to_sign.

content.description: New text (re-embedded). Provide at least one of content/tags/metadata/source.

tools.name: memory_history
tools.description:
[Wicked Memory] Full version chain for a memory, oldest first, with valid_from / valid_until / superseded_by. Works from any version's id.

Use when you want a memory's full version chain and validity windows. Not for its current content (use memory_get).

Behavior: read-only.

memory_id.description: UUID of any version in the chain.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over memory_prepare's message_to_sign.

tools.name: memory_delete
tools.description:
[Wicked Memory] PERMANENTLY hard-delete a memory (right-to-be-forgotten). Default scope "chain" removes every version; "version" only this one. Only an audit row (no content) is kept.

Use when you must permanently erase a memory (right to be forgotten). Not for correcting it (use memory_update, which keeps history).

Behavior: DESTRUCTIVE and not reversible; confirm intent before calling.

memory_id.description: UUID of any version in the chain.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over memory_prepare's message_to_sign.

tools.name: memory_deletions
tools.description:
[Wicked Memory] Your deletion audit log (ids, times, reasons; never content).

Use when you want your audit log of deletions (ids, times, reasons, never content). Not for recovering content, which is gone.

Behavior: read-only.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over memory_prepare's message_to_sign.

tools.name: paywall_demo_weather
tools.description:
[x402 Paywall] Call the live demo route on the paywall gateway (GET /wickedapi/weather) to see a real x402 challenge: unpaid, it returns HTTP 402 with the decoded price, network and payTo in payment_required. A safe way to learn what a paywalled endpoint looks like before creating your own.

Use when you want to see a real x402 payment challenge from a paywalled route (price, network, payTo) without creating anything. Not for setting up your own paywall (use paywall_signup then paywall_create_route).

Behavior: read-only.

tools.name: paywall_signup
tools.description:
[x402 Paywall] Create a tenant account. Returns a Bearer apiKey ONCE — store it and set PAYWALL_API_KEY. Rate-limited to 5/hour per IP.

Use when you want a paywall tenant account and its API key (shown once). Not for managing routes of an existing tenant.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

slug.description: Lowercase a-z0-9 and hyphens, 2-40 chars; becomes your mount path prefix /{slug}.

tools.name: paywall_get_tenant
tools.description:
[x402 Paywall] Your tenant record (needs PAYWALL_API_KEY).

Use when you want your tenant record (name, slug, key hint). Not for route management.

Behavior: read-only.

tools.name: paywall_list_routes
tools.description:
[x402 Paywall] List your paywalled routes (needs PAYWALL_API_KEY).

Use when you want your paywalled routes and their prices. Not for earnings (use paywall_list_settlements).

Behavior: read-only.

tools.name: paywall_create_route
tools.description:
[x402 Paywall] Paywall a new endpoint with x402 pay-per-call, settled in USDC straight to payTo. With upstreamUrl, paid requests are proxied to your backend. Applies live within ~20s (needs PAYWALL_API_KEY).

Use when you want to put one HTTP endpoint behind x402 pay-per-call, paid in USDC straight to your wallet. Not for many routes at once (use paywall_import_routes).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

network.description: CAIP-2 id: Base mainnet eip155:8453, Base Sepolia eip155:84532.

payTo.description: Your payout wallet (0x…). Settlement pays here directly; nothing is custodied.

asset.description: Payment token contract; defaults to USDC on the network.

description.description: Up to 200 chars: letters, digits, space . _ -

upstreamUrl.description: Your https backend. Omit for the demo confirmation payload.

tools.name: paywall_import_routes
tools.description:
[x402 Paywall] Bulk upsert routes keyed on (method, path) — paywall a whole API in one call (needs PAYWALL_API_KEY).

Use when you want to paywall many routes in one call (upsert on method and path). Not for a single route (use paywall_create_route).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

network.description: CAIP-2 id: Base mainnet eip155:8453, Base Sepolia eip155:84532.

payTo.description: Your payout wallet (0x…). Settlement pays here directly; nothing is custodied.

asset.description: Payment token contract; defaults to USDC on the network.

description.description: Up to 200 chars: letters, digits, space . _ -

upstreamUrl.description: Your https backend. Omit for the demo confirmation payload.

routes.description: Route objects, same fields as paywall_create_route.

tools.name: paywall_update_route
tools.description:
[x402 Paywall] Partial update of a route (e.g. change price or payout wallet); applies live within ~20s (needs PAYWALL_API_KEY).

Use when you want to change a route's price, payout wallet or upstream without a redeploy. Not for creating or deleting routes.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

network.description: CAIP-2 id: Base mainnet eip155:8453, Base Sepolia eip155:84532.

payTo.description: Your payout wallet (0x…). Settlement pays here directly; nothing is custodied.

asset.description: Payment token contract; defaults to USDC on the network.

description.description: Up to 200 chars: letters, digits, space . _ -

upstreamUrl.description: Your https backend. Omit for the demo confirmation payload.

tools.name: paywall_delete_route
tools.description:
[x402 Paywall] Remove a paywalled route; applies within ~20s (needs PAYWALL_API_KEY).

Use when you want a route removed from the paywall. Not for changing its price (use paywall_update_route).

Behavior: DESTRUCTIVE and not reversible; confirm intent before calling.

tools.name: paywall_list_settlements
tools.description:
[x402 Paywall] Your real on-chain USDC settlements (earnings) (needs PAYWALL_API_KEY).

Use when you want your real on-chain USDC settlements (earnings). Not for route configuration (use paywall_list_routes).

Behavior: read-only.
